releaseNotes: 0.4.5: custom question banks now live in a dropdown that filters the list by bank, a persistent Reset Progress button clears all progress and drafts with a two-step confirmation, SQL drafts are stored through host.storage so they survive restarts, cancelling an export no longer reports success, and the workbench gets a redesigned header with light and dark themes, sticky result table headers, zebra rows, narrow-screen layout and reduced-motion support. Local-only: no database connection, no network.
